post_topic: LLM-agnostic architecture as the answer to vendor lock-in gaps in enterprise AI stacks
scene_description: A split architectural diagram showing two contrasting AI stack designs side by side: on the left, application code wired directly to hardcoded OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Anthropic endpoints with embeddings APIs tightly coupled, labeled as fragile; on the right, a clean routing layer acting as a provider interface that normalizes inputs and returns typed responses, sitting above interchangeable models — GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini 1.5 Pro — with tenant-scoped HITL policy checkpoints beneath the orchestration layer, labeled as Cloud Decoded architecture. The tension is between the 70% vendor lock-in path that breaks on model deprecation versus the provider-agnostic design that survives both model changes and compliance audits.
